has_existing_aggregation = (
            any(
                getattr(annotation, "contains_aggregate", True)
                for annotation in self.annotations.values()
            )
            or having
        )
        # Aggregating over a window function requires the window function to be
        # evaluated in a subquery as window functions cannot be nested within
        # aggregate functions.
        has_window_functions = any(
            getattr(annotation, "contains_over_clause", False)
            for annotation in self.annotations.values()
        )
        # Decide if we need to use a subquery.
